en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neo‑classical colonnade along a river or canal, crowded with elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing. The long colonnaded building has statues on the roofline and ornate arches, backed by a wooded hillside and several large spa hotels or villas. Printed caption text in German at the top reads "Karlsbad. Mühlbrunnen-Kolonnade."
